description.p: Stonks follows shares, funds, indices, currencies and crypto, and shows how a portfolio would have done had you bought when you say you did. Nothing is traded and there is no account: a symbol can be given a buy date and a number of shares, or simply be watched.

ul.li: A heatmap of everything you follow, sorted into folders you lay out yourself
Charts from one day to a symbol's whole history
Gains and losses per holding and in total, in the currency you choose
US, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hong Kong and Vietnamese exchanges, among others
Prices are kept on disk, so it opens at once and works offline with what it has

description.p: Prices come from Yahoo Finance and other public sources. They can be delayed or wrong and are not investment advice. Stonks is not affiliated with any of its sources.
